title: Derived representative transport through coefficient equivalence
statement: Let X be a scheme and B,C,D commutative rings in universe t. Let q:B → C be a ring homomorphism and ρ:C ≃ D a ring equivalence. Let P be a K-flat B-complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let L with counit ε be a total left derived extension along q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-module-base-change]. Let K be restriction along ρ inverse of the canonical complex representative of L(Q(P)). Assuming the D-valued Koszul constant functor preserves zero morphisms, the finite constant model [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data] over D of ordinary scalar extension of P along ρ composed with q is isomorphic in the derived category to the finite constant model of K.

source.place: Tags 0D6D and 093J; derived pullback composition and exact coefficient transport

proof.text: Extension of scalars preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. The K-flat derivability criterion therefore makes the specified derived counit ε invertible on P. Compose with the quotient-to-derived factorization to identify L(Q(P)) with Q(q ⊗ P).

The inverse coefficient restriction is an exact equivalence. By uniqueness of left adjoints, extension along ρ is its inverse restriction functor. The scalar-extension composition isomorphism identifies extension along ρ composed with q with successive extension followed by this restriction. Apply the derived restriction to the preceding isomorphism and the canonical localization representative.

Apply exact constant realization, including ModuleCat.uliftFunctor and restriction along the ULift ring equivalence, to transport this derived isomorphism to the sheaf category. The same exactness proves finiteModel_constantComplex_mapIso. For the caller, the proved unbounded flat-resolution construction gives finiteModel_exists_kFlat_representative; the free-forgetful counit supplies functorial flat epimorphisms in the original module universe.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 0G7E and 0D6D; sites-modules.tex Tag 093J. K-flat counit computation, exact coefficient transport, and resolution invariance.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteModel_derivedRepresentative_transport
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {B C D : Type t} [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    (q : B →+* C) (ρ : C ≃+* D)
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X D).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{t} B) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} B) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} C))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      @Functor.mapHomotopyCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ModuleCat.extendScalars q)
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj q).left_adjoint_additive
        (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hL : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ))) :
    let K := ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t} ρ.symm.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.objPreimage (L.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
    Nonempty
      ((@DerivedCategory.Q (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} (adicModuleRing X D)) _ _).obj
          (finiteModelConstantComplex X D
            (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (ρ.toRingHom.comp q)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≅
        (@DerivedCategory.Q (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} (adicModuleRing X D)) _ _).obj
          (finiteModelConstantComplex X D K))
